personalization.campaignGoal: Get Pulse in front of 16–24s on the platforms they actually open, without turning the brand into a meme — and show the board a number by the end of the quarter.
personalization.campaignIdea: "Pulse Check": a weekly creator drop where one guest has 60 seconds to do something they've been putting off — with a can in hand. Same format every week, a new face every time, so the audience learns the rhythm and comes back for the next one.
